facts.text: Audrey has a tattoo of four dogs and has added a flower tattoo on her wrist.

evidence.quote: I think i've said this so many times, but I really can't imagine my life without them - my little family. They always make me smile and give lots of love and companionship. Remember I had a tattoo of my four dogs? So I went to the tattoo parlor and got some more drawings on the tattoo.
Maybe I'll get another tattoo when that happens.

facts.text: Audrey has a tattoo of a dog and sunflowers on her wrist.

evidence.quote: Maybe I'll get another tattoo when that happens. [image: a photo of a woman with a tattoo of a dog and sunflowers]

facts.text: Audrey's dogs bring her joy and companionship.

evidence.quote: They always make me smile and give lots of love and companionship.

facts.text: Audrey has expressed that she is currently satisfied with her tattoos and may add more in the future.

evidence.quote: I think right now its enough. Unless someday I decide to get another dog. Maybe I'll get another tattoo when that happens.
